authority_note: Supabase Postgres and typed application contracts remain the system of record. This ontology is a CI-only semantic projection; it never acts as a runtime graph authority and no graph service is introduced.

competency_questions.title: What is still believed about this Subject since last quarter?
What changed in evidence vs only in brief/lens?
Which recommendations did the client reject (and must not revive)?
Where do intended positioning and public perception diverge?
Which channels are Managed vs Observed for this tenant?
Why did Branding score move +N since the last run?

invalid_fixtures.summary: An ObservedTarget asserted as a ManagedRelationship — one-off public audit targets must never appear as managed workspace property.
A Channel asserted as a Subject — a channel is one presence of a durable Subject and must never itself be the Subject.
An IntelligenceRun without brief/evidence-snapshot/version pins — every run pins all contract versions.
Evidence missing observed_at and carrying an undersized content hash — every EvidenceItem needs full provenance.

A Recommendation in a decided state (accepted) with no backing ClientDecision — decided recommendations must be resolved by exactly one decision via alm:decidesOn; rejected advice must not revive without new evidence (temporal policy, SQL twin Q3).
A ReportVersion asserted as an Audit — reports are immutable audience projections of a pinned run, never the queue/billing unit.

limitations: Postgres (Supabase) remains system of record; this projection is CI-only documentation, never a runtime graph authority.

Immutability and append-only enforcement (UPDATE/DELETE rejection) are SQL-enforced closed-world policies; SHACL cannot express them, so they are drift-asserted against docs/architecture-contract.md and reported UNKNOWN-in-SHACL.
Rejected recommendation non-revival is temporal SQL/application policy; SHACL covers only the typed decision-on-recommendation relationship.
Fixtures verify semantic/software consistency only; they do not prove customer efficacy, model calibration, or production database state.
